author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0006307 | DNA alkylation repair | IEA with IPR009210


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC15D4.13c
https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8N9N2/entry (needs updating at uniProt, will challenge)

* **Description of issue**

This gene has been associated with many processes, but recently it has been shown to be part of ribosome assembly

The ASC-1 Complex Disassembles Collided Ribosomes
PMID: 32579943 

[The ASC-1 complex promotes translation initiation by scanning ribosomes.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37092320/)
Kito Y, Matsumoto A, Ichihara K, Shiraishi C, Tang R, Hatano A, Matsumoto M, Han P, Iwasaki S, Nakayama KI.
 PMID: 37092320

[Ribosomal collision is not a prerequisite for ZNF598-mediated ribosome ubiquitination and disassembly of ribosomal complexes by ASCC](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38366554/)
PMID: 38366554
 
[Unresolved stalled ribosome complexes restrict cell-cycle progression after genotoxic stress.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35180429/)
Stoneley M, Harvey RF, Mulroney TE, Mordue R, Jukes-Jones R, Cain K, Lilley KS, Sawarkar R, Willis AE.
Mol Cell. 2022 Apr 21;82(8):1557-1572.e7. doi: 10.1016/j.molcel.2022.01.019. Epub 2022 Feb 17.
PMID: 35180429

The " DNA alkylation repair" is old and weak and seems to all be derived from PMID: 29997253
